-- Termine morgen, die noch keinen 24h-Reminder bekommen haben
SELECT
  b.id AS booking_id,
  b.salon_id,
  b.start_time,
  b.end_time,
  s.name AS service_name,
  st.name AS staff_name,
  c.first_name AS client_name,
  c.phone AS client_phone,
  c.last_name,
  sal.name AS salon_name,
  sal.phone AS salon_phone
FROM bookings b
JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id
JOIN staff st ON st.id = b.staff_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = b.client_id
JOIN salons sal ON sal.id = b.salon_id
WHERE b.status = 'confirmed'
  AND b.reminder_24h_sent = false
  AND b.start_time::date = (CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY b.start_time;

-- Reminder als gesendet markieren
UPDATE bookings
SET reminder_24h_sent = true, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.booking_id }}';

-- Message Log eintragen
INSERT INTO message_log (salon_id, client_id, channel, direction, template_name, message_text, related_booking_id)
SELECT
  b.salon_id,
  b.client_id,
  'whatsapp',
  'outbound',
  'reminder_24h',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  b.id
FROM bookings b WHERE b.id = '{{ $json.booking_id }}';

-- Termine in 1 Stunde, die noch keinen 1h-Reminder haben
SELECT
  b.id AS booking_id,
  b.salon_id,
  b.start_time,
  s.name AS service_name,
  st.name AS staff_name,
  c.first_name AS client_name,
  c.phone AS client_phone,
  sal.name AS salon_name,
  sal.address_street
FROM bookings b
JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id
JOIN staff st ON st.id = b.staff_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = b.client_id
JOIN salons sal ON sal.id = b.salon_id
WHERE b.status = 'confirmed'
  AND b.reminder_1h_sent = false
  AND b.confirmed_by_client = false
  AND b.start_time BETWEEN NOW() + INTERVAL '45 minutes' AND NOW() + INTERVAL '75 minutes'
ORDER BY b.start_time;
UPDATE bookings SET reminder_1h_sent = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.booking_id }}';

## WhatsApp Senden

Hier wird der WhatsApp-Node eingefügt sobald
360dialog / WABA konfiguriert ist.

Bis dahin: Message wird geloggt und
kann manuell versendet werden.

### Platzhalter-Nodes:
- 360dialog HTTP Request Node
- Oder: n8n WhatsApp Business Node

### Template bei Meta einreichen:
- `reminder_24h` — Termin-Erinnerung 24h
- `reminder_1h` — Termin-Erinnerung 1h
